# @forge/cli-shared

## 9.10.0

### Minor Changes

- f5c6898: Preparation for new `forge deploy retry` command, which retries the failed placement deployments of an app version in an environment, and `forge deploy status` now suggests it after a failure
- 400465b: Add `--non-interactive` to every command and a `non-interactive` setting (`auto`, `on`, `off`; `FORGE_NON_INTERACTIVE` overrides it). `auto`, the default, turns the mode on when an agent runs the command (no terminal on stdin or stdout). CI (`CI=true`) is left out: pipelines keep today's behaviour unless they pass `--non-interactive` or set `on`. The flag, `on` and `auto` with an agent all give the same mode: commands skip their confirms (including destructive ones such as `forge environments delete`), required options are checked as `--non-interactive` always did (for example `forge install` needs `--site`, `--product` and `--environment`), and a missing one, a missing default environment, or any remaining prompt fails at once with a `MISSING_INPUT` error instead of waiting. A missing analytics choice fails, as `--non-interactive` always has (set it with `forge settings set usage-analytics <value>`). Set `forge settings set non-interactive off` (or `FORGE_NON_INTERACTIVE=off`) to keep prompts for an agent.
- e865360: Bump @forge/util with latest aris and dependencies
- aabae59: Preparation for the new `forge deploy status` command, which shows the placement deployment status of an app version in an environment
- c47e5e2: `forge create` non-interactive mode performs input validation with improved error messaging.

### Patch Changes

- fadba81: Wording updates for the new `forge deploy retry` and `forge deploy status` cli commands.
- 480d776: Allow preset flag to be used for forge create --non-interactive
- 5809b64: Keep non-interactive mode opt-in for now. The `non-interactive` setting defaults to `off`, so only `--non-interactive` (or `forge settings set non-interactive on|auto`, or `FORGE_NON_INTERACTIVE`) turns it on; agents and pipelines behave as before until protected actions are guarded. The setting is left out of `forge settings list`, and `--non-interactive` is hidden from the help of commands that don't support it yet, including `forge create` and `forge register`. Every command still accepts the flag
- 3c8b168: Prepare `forge deploy` to report the app artifact upload and the background placement deployment, with a `forge deploy status` hint, once the status command is no longer hidden. The output is unchanged until then.
- fdd24a6: Hidden preset command to forge create

## 9.9.0

### Minor Changes

- 4bff8be: Added `forge skills install`, `forge skills status` and `forge skills remove` to install the latest Forge developer skills from `main` and configure the Forge and ADS MCP servers for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI and Visual Studio Code, at user or project scope. Install supports `--skill`, `--dry-run` and `--no-mcp`. After an interactive `forge login`, the CLI suggests `forge skills install` when an AI agent is installed but no Forge skills or MCP servers are set up.

  `sendWithNodeRequest` now keeps binary HTTP response bodies intact, so downloaded archives are not corrupted by text decoding.

- f935aa9: Added the `--open` option to `forge console`, which also opens the developer console link in your default browser. The link is now printed on its own line so it is easier to copy.
- 4dd1a11: Add stg-gcentral as env and setup forge csp for gcp service urls
- 8693a88: Added an optional `--placement` filter to `forge logs`, which limits the logs returned to a given placement. Placements can be regions, isolation contexts (for example `ic-dr6`) or Customer Data Planes (for example `cdp-bb0`).

### Patch Changes

- 5a91774: Updated test tooling to Jest 30, migrated test matchers and snapshot headers, and added coverage for translation caching and permission ordering. Removed a redundant private validation guard while preserving the public validation checks.
- 30bee86: forge create now points you to the Developer Console, where you can add contributors to the new app
- b1f95d4: Revert keyid in the response when creating authenticated webtrigger urls, and disable authenticated webtrigger e2e tests
- 3a275b0: Show Not Available when container cpu and memory values are unknown
- 8b9c106: update transitive dependency brace-expansion 5.0.4 -> 5.0.12
- 94f9b5c: Include package manager output in `forge module add` errors, and recover the custom-ui module add e2e test when npm skips rolldown's native binding

## 9.8.0

### Minor Changes

- 879bdfe: `forge webtrigger create`, `list` and `delete` can now route installation-scoped GraphQL requests through the installation's site gateway (`https://<site>/gateway/api/graphql`) instead of the global gateway. This is enabled only when `FORGE_GRAPHQL_GATEWAY=https://api-private.stg.atlassian.com/graphql` and `FORGE_BLUEBIRD_ENABLED=true` are set.
- 0700ef3: Removed the ECR fallback when pulling the Forge tunnel proxy-sidecar image. Tunnel now pulls that image only from the portable registry.
- 5ca5f14: Display a deprecation warning on `forge deploy` and `forge install` when the app uses the confluence:fullPage or jira:fullPage module, recommending global:fullPage instead
- a68050a: Removed the TypeScript bundler EAP. Use manual packaging instead, running `tsc` or another compiler yourself.

### Patch Changes

- 0df8dc0: Allow app.compatibility.bitbucket with required: false in the manifest schema template.
- 0b5d453: Compile workspace packages with module/moduleResolution nodenext. Packages still emit CommonJS, aligned with the CLI’s Node 22+ runtime.

  Drop package-root TypeScript paths aliases in favour of package.json exports and barrel files. @forge/kvs now exports QueryBuilderOptions from the package root. @forge/manifest publishes a types-only @forge/manifest/schema subpath.

- 1456635: Bumping dependencies via Renovate:

  - adm-zip
  - @types/adm-zip

- 07e2daa: Bumping dependencies

  - @vercel/detect-agent\
  - @babel/core
  - @babel/parser
  - @babel/plugin-transform-class-properties
  - @babel/plugin-transform-class-static-block
  - @babel/plugin-transform-numeric-separator
  - @babel/plugin-transform-optional-chaining
  - @babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx
  - @babel/traverse
  - @babel/types

- f08d968: Consolidate `forge tunnel`'s local Container Services artifacts (`.services/` and `.container-service-assets/`) under the existing `.forge/` directory, so tunnelling only ever adds a single hidden directory to the project root instead of two/three separate ones.

## 9.7.0

### Minor Changes

- c2f6468: Removed the "Global (EAP)" product option from `forge create`. Global templates are now listed under the Jira, Confluence, and Multiple products, and set `app.compatibility` to match the selected product. The global product in `forge module add` is now labelled "Global".
- 82730f2: Added container services to version details tables, interactive property selection, version summaries, and comparison tables.
- 9f27f8a: Update uninstall flow to improve user experience and support global apps
- cf81630: Wire up global apps installer into existing flow for EAP
- a384019: Add identity client for listing orgs and units
- e7dc317: Warn when Teamwork Graph API usage is detected without graph scopes in the manifest, with guidance to review scope documentation. The warning does not block builds or automatically add scopes.
- 9d391ab: `forge show services` and `forge show containers` now read every placement the app is deployed to, by paginating the `appContainerServices` query instead of reading only the first placement. Both commands report which placement each service and container runs in, so a service deployed to more than one placement is no longer collapsed into a single row.
- 988dff5: Replace the `--shard` option on the `forge show` commands with `--placement`, which takes a bare placement ID such as `ic-dr6` or `us-east-1`. The `appContainerServices` query now filters on `PLACEMENT` using a fully qualified `EcosystemAppPlacementAri`, with the placement type derived from the ID.
- 4740d03: Add new controller and ui to support global install flow EAP

### Patch Changes

- 2a491b9: Increase the timeout for deployment artifact and hosted resource uploads from 30s to 5 minutes.
- fb0dbe8: Global app installs no longer mark connections as linked, so you can connect the same Atlassian app or platform tool more than once (for example, multiple Jira sites).
- b090628: Add new empty spinner for long loading
- 385ac1a: Adding new UI text to support global apps EAP
- c0b2b2a: Support global apps install for app-id-override flag
- 56fd47c: Bumping dependencies via Renovate:

  - @graphql-tools/schema

- 93f4631: Improved artifact too large error messages to include limits
- b77e195: Improved rendering performance for multiline tables, including `forge version compare`.
- 78af9a2: Always bundle the Node runtime loader, removing the forge-cli-bundle-runtime-loader feature gate
- 797ac88: Add tests for manual packaging
- ea3b2ba: Implement error message for deployment failure due to exceededing file size for skill directory
- 3e160b1: Generate GraphQL types from CLI `graphql()` documents with `@graphql-codegen/client-preset` and `onlyOperationTypes`. Stop star-exporting the 27MB gateway dump from `@forge/cli-shared`.
- 608da16: Align GraphQL dependency ranges with the workspace root to fix dependency linking.

## 9.6.0

### Minor Changes

- 4f14f40: Added the `forge console` command to open your app in the developer console overview page. The command prints a link to the console for the current app (identified by the manifest).

  Refactored developer console URL construction to use a centralized registry pattern (`getDevConsoleUrl`), replacing `getAppOverviewUrl` and `getDeveloperConsoleBaseUrl`. This fixes hardcoded production-domain URLs that broke on staging (`forge deploy` distribution link and `forge install` permission-denied link now work correctly on staging). All console links are now clickable terminal links.

- 406407c: Added secret key support for authorised web-triggers, plus non-expiring keys via `--noKeyExpiry` on `forge webtrigger create` and `secretKeyConfig.noExpiry` in `@forge/api`
- a4ba041: Remove the `-p` shorthand for the `--placement` option of `forge manifest render`, because it is reserved for `--product`. The option is otherwise unchanged.
- febf70d: Improve forge install list output

### Patch Changes

- 1b28613: Add building blocks for global app uninstall flow
- 87d6f62: Add forge rollout command
- c7d6a28: Added additional --json to various commands
- 445988f: Route CLI warnings and errors to stderr
- cae833a: Removed web trigger URL creation from `forge webtrigger`. The deprecation window has passed, so use `forge webtrigger create` instead.
- a5a58d4: Link to the tunnel port documentation when a service has an invalid tunnel port.

## 9.0.0

### Major Changes

- 78fcb7f: Adds support for TypeScript 5

### Minor Changes

- 6aeecd7: The tunnel debugger now binds to localhost (127.0.0.1) by default instead of all network interfaces (0.0.0.0). If you need to attach a debugger from another host, use the new `--debugHost` option on `forge tunnel` to specify the IP address to bind to.
- 39d4f9d: forge show command
- 2a1ec30: Adding warning when site has over 100 apps installed

### Patch Changes

- c3b96b3: Show warning when install fails
- 2a03b88: `isAgent` attribution now excludes CI: `isAgent()` returns `false` when `CI=true` even if stdin/stdout are non-TTY, so the `isAgent` and `isCI` signals never overlap in the `atl-attribution` header and analytics payload.
- 561f8f4: Remove "storage" module from "@forge/api"
- ab1dcaa: Update JSM to be its own product
- 4a191fe: Mark the `module` command and its subcommands (`add`, `list`, `show`) as `[Preview]` and add a caution to the `module`/`module add` help noting that running these commands may modify your app files (manifest.yml, source files, and package.json).
- bb903a8: Update requireAppId check
- c1acc55: Add Prod Service
- 5b67e61: Patch fixes for module Add
- 9a6de66: module list command
- 55c1371: bump cheerio to ^1.2.0 to pull in a patched undici (>=7.19.0, resolving to a fixed release) and remediate CVE-2026-1525
  NodeJS requirement bumped from 20.0.0 to >=20.18.1

## 8.23.0

### Minor Changes

- 30060eb: Emit `isAgent`/`isCI` on GASv3 analytics events via a new shared `ForgeCliAttribution` class, used by both the `atl-attribution` GraphQL header and analytics client.
- 369bc9b: `ForgeCliAttribution.agentHint()` now delegates agent detection to [`@vercel/detect-agent`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vercel/detect-agent), expanding coverage and replacing the previous brittle PATH-based heuristic. The set of recognised agents is defined by the upstream library. Rovo Dev and Windsurf are still detected directly within `ForgeCliAttribution` and take precedence over the library's result. `agentHint()` and `build()` are now `async` and must be `await`ed by callers.
- 3bbb9da: Extend `ForgeCliAttribution` to emit additional fields on the `atl-attribution` GraphQL header and GASv3 analytics events: `skillName`, `agentHint` (auto-detects rovo-dev, claude-code, cursor, codex, antigravity, opencode, windsurf, gemini, github-copilot), and `isStudio`. All three are sourced from reserved `ATL_FORGE_ATTRIBUTION_*` env vars with input validation. Adds a generic `ATL_FORGE_ATTRIBUTION_<KEY>` wildcard pass-through so additional attribution fields can be supplied via environment variables (with key/value validation and reserved-field protection)
- 808adbd: Grouped commands in CLI help and commander.js version bump
- e2113b4: introduce `--skipRollout` for `forge deploy`
- a885062: Support a limit parameter in the version bulk-upgrade start command

### Patch Changes

- 84d9930: adding option to include installation-id for uninstall flow
- 2c85db9: Add option to create global app
- ef0434d: Added support for multi-entry resources in UI Kit applications, enabling developers to define multiple entry points within a single resource.

### Minor Changes

- 16894cf: Extend the `atl-attribution` header sent on every GraphQL request from the Forge CLI with two new fields:

  - `isAgent` — `true` when stdin and stdout is not a TTY (e.g. running under Rovo Dev, Cursor, or another agent shell).
  - `isCI` — `true` when the `CI` environment variable is set to the literal string `"true"` (matches the `isCI` check already used by `forge build` / `forge deploy` packaging telemetry).

## 5.0.0

### Major Changes

- 5c2c20f: Fixed the issue where the CLI was unable to bundle modules with multiple entrypoints using different resource types.

  Specifically the following configuration that supports both UI Kit and Custom UI resources are now supported properly.

  ```yaml
  modules:
    jira:customFieldType:
      - key: my_custom_field_app
        resource: ui-kit-resource
        render: native
        contextConfig:
          resource: custom-ui-resource
  ```

  In the previous CLI version, the above configuration would assume that the `custom-ui-resource` is a UI Kit resource
  and would expected a UI Kit based resource is linked. To support using same resource type for multiple entrypoints,
  in above example, please add `render: native` to the `contextConfig` to correct the resource type:

  ```yaml
  modules:
    jira:customFieldType:
      - key: my_custom_field_app
        resource: ui-kit-resource
        render: native
        contextConfig:
          resource: ui-kit-resource
          render: native
  ```

### Patch Changes

- 670a419: Only parse listed environment variables in the manifest
